name: Portugal
headline: THE *PORTUGAL* NOBODY TELLS YOU ABOUT
intro: Everyone lands in Lisbon and drives south. The part worth your week is the 300km you went past on the way.

mustSee.name: Lisbon
mustSee.note: Worth the crowds. Ride tram 28 before eight or don't bother.

mustSee.name: Porto
mustSee.note: Two days minimum. Cross the Dom Luís I bridge on the upper deck, walk back on the lower.

mustSee.name: Sintra
mustSee.note: Pena Palace is as good as people say and as busy as people warn. First entry slot or skip it.

mustSee.name: Douro Valley
mustSee.note: Terraced vineyards on both banks. The train from Porto runs the whole way along the river.

mustSee.name: The Algarve
mustSee.note: Genuinely beautiful. In August it is a car park with a beach attached. Go in May.

seasons.spring: March to May is the best window. Alentejo is green, the sea is still cold, and rooms cost half what they will in July.
seasons.summer: July and August are hot and full. The interior passes 40°C most weeks. North of Porto the coast stays usable.
seasons.autumn: September and October. Harvest in the Douro, warmest sea of the year, and the coach parties have gone.
seasons.winter: Wet in the north, bright and mild in the south. Some interior guesthouses shut from November to February — ring ahead.

transport: Trains connect Lisbon, Coimbra and Porto properly — book the Alfa Pendular a day ahead and it's cheap. East of that line you need a car; buses to the interior villages run twice a day at best. The Douro line from Porto to Pocinho is worth a day on its own, and you can put a bike on it.
